answer: Locks are written down in umber, expire in ivory, and ferrous lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 39 aliases therefore needs 100 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 16 dollars in locked collateral and another 12 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
